name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, meaning all organic activity is carrying the load. Google Business Profile drove 117 total actions (88 directions, 27 web clicks, 2 calls), though GBP engagement dropped 100% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely due to a listing issue or a seasonal slowdown worth investigating immediately.

performance.verdict: GBP dark for 9 days; all paid channels silent — organic floor has collapsed.

findings.text: GBP actions hit 0 for 9 consecutive days (Sep 1–8) after averaging ~6/day Aug 12–30. The listing is likely suspended or suppressed.
3 overdue CRM blockers: 342 stub reconciliation, Tom call list (Jul 28), and 1st Directives close-out (Jul 7) — all unconfirmed complete as of today.
2 more overdue SOW blockers: AGS + Forte contact pull (Outreach, due Aug 31) and Web/SEO root-cause fix submission (due Aug 31) — no completion event recorded.
GA4 sessions and Search Console clicks read 0 for all 28 days — either tracking is broken or no web traffic is being captured; organic safety net is unmeasured.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing status immediately — 9 days of zero actions vs prior ~6/day average signals suspension or owner verification lapse.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on Sep 1 and have remained at 0 through Sep 8 (9 straight days), against a prior 28-day average of ~6 actions/day and a total of 117 actions in the window. Log into Google Business Profile today and check for suspension notices, ownership verification requests, or listing edits pending review. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return above 3/day for 3 consecutive days — re-check Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 and Search Console — 28 days of zero sessions/clicks may indicate broken tracking; confirm before drawing any organic conclusions.

Confirm that the GA4 property ID in the reporting pipeline matches the live site tag, and that GSC ownership is verified for the correct domain.
